methodology: Probability bands are baseline model outputs (usage trend, health score, days_to_renewal decay). Manual adjustments: +10% if formal exec check-in scheduled within 14 days, +15% if finance PO confirmed, -20% if any open Sev2/Sev1 ticket > 30d, -10% if primary contact changed in last 60d. Weighted ARR = sum(ARR_USD * renewal_probability_pct).
